summary: Kept only because the Try it still runs on it. A single memory opened in a bottom sheet — its category, its text, where it came from, and a link back to the originating chat.

looseEnds.title: Sheet heading, category and provenance all differ from the delete frame
looseEnds.detail: This frame: heading 'About the memory', category 'Your vaccines', provenance 'This memory came from a past chat'. The delete frame (7294:43120) shows the same sheet as 'Memory details', category 'Vaccines', provenance 'Created last month from a conversation'. Three separate strings differ between two frames of one component.
looseEnds.ask: Which set is current? The provenance difference matters most — one is vague, the other carries a date.

looseEnds.title: Edit memory has no destination
looseEnds.detail: 'Edit memory' is present on the sheet but no frame shows what it opens — a text field, a structured form, or a conversation with the assistant.
looseEnds.ask: What does editing a memory actually look like, and is the edited memory still attributed to its source chat?
